# MiniHero mod-making guide

> Bilingual C# mod tutorials for players. Guide revision 5; Mod API 1.8.0; 2026-10-14.

Help the player change their existing game-generated mod project. Ask for the relevant source and package.json when needed. Follow one lesson at a time, keep the package ID, namespace, single entry point and localization keys, and explain where edits go and how the player can see the result.

## Look up the task

- [English supported features](docs/en/feature-map.md)
- [中文可用功能](docs/zh-CN/feature-map.md)
- [English source files and dependencies](templates/README.md)
- [中文源码与依赖](templates/README.zh-CN.md)
- [Capability routes and limitations](docs/capabilities.json)
- [Selected API declarations](docs/api-surface.json)
- [Troubleshooting](docs/en/troubleshooting.md)
- [排错指南](docs/zh-CN/troubleshooting.md)

Gameplay is written in C# content classes and compiled with the player's game-generated API/Core references. package.json is package metadata; localization JSON holds displayed text. These are not gameplay recipes. The repository does not contain SDK DLLs.

Use the semantic reference as well as signatures. Healing-linked rules read settled AfterHealingEvent.requested; actual is HP-bar gain. Temporary treasure state resets per stage by default. Pool matching uses any shared tag. Card faces are previews, not executable item behaviors; choice resolvers use stable IDs. The game has no player mod-settings menu or public configuration writer. Loaded C# changes need a full restart.

Deliver complete files or clearly bounded edits, required registrations, a way for content to appear and corresponding text entries. Do not invent missing APIs or claim tests that did not run. Keep the player's work intact and start without custom image bindings when artwork is not available.

Documentation contributors should also read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Players following lessons do not need documentation-maintenance scripts, Unity or the game's source project.
